description: This file defines the MemoryStreamQueueGrain class, which implements a memory-based streaming queue grain used for enqueuing and dequeuing event data in Orleans. It manages a queue with a maximum size, supports migration through hydration/dehydration, and interacts with external grain interfaces.

classes.name: MemoryStreamQueueGrain
classes.description: A grain class serving as a memory-based event queue supporting enqueue, dequeue, and migration operations.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Adds an event data item to the queue, enforcing a maximum size limit.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Retrieves up to maxCount event data items from the queue.

methods.name: OnDehydrate
methods.description: Handles dehydration by saving the current queue state into the dehydration context for migration.

methods.name: OnRehydrate
methods.description: Handles rehydration by restoring the queue state from the rehydration context during migration.
